name: Fish-containing baby foods

Pb.basis_note: Direct EU maximum for baby food for infants and young children (20 ug/kg). The explicit lookup avoids treating the regulation's 'except ... formula' wording as a product-scope exclusion.

tHg.label: Sovereign infant-food read-across from Israel's 8 ug/kg total-mercury maximum. This is stricter than the seafood mercury tier and therefore governs the finished baby food.
tHg.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

MeHg.label: Methylmercury is a component of total mercury (MeHg ≤ tHg). No government sets a methylmercury limit for this product below the binding total-mercury ceiling (8 µg/kg), so methylmercury is governed by and bounded by the total-mercury ceiling; no separate methylmercury ceiling is published.

Sn.label: India FSSAI non-canned infant-food total-tin maximum (5000 ug/kg), applied at face value.
Sn.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Al.label: Conservative sovereign infant-food read-across from the AU-NZ non-soy infant-formula aluminium maximum (500 ug/kg).
Al.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cr.label: India FSSAI total-chromium maximum for all fishery products (12000 ug/kg), read across to the fish component of the finished baby food.
Cr.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cr-VI.control: Total chromium is measured on every lot. Any total-Cr result at or above 100 ug/kg triggers Cr(VI) speciation, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails certification.
Cr-VI.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS; Cr(VI) by EPA 3060A alkaline extraction with IC-ICP-MS (EPA 6800 / EN 15192 or equivalent).

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, 8:1 basis, read-across)
